title: Mini Vanish Airbrush Pressed Powder
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A talc-free, sheer, pressed powder clinically shown to instantly reduce shine for an airbrushed finish that lasts all day.


Coverage: Light


Finish: Matte


Formulation: Pressed Powder


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, sulfates SLS & SLES, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This weightless, shine-controlling powder allows you to set, perfect, and touch up on the go. This non-drying formula instantly absorbs excess oil while minimizing and blurring.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-For all-over application, dust on with a powder brush.

-For touch-ups, use the puff applicator to pick up a small amount of product and apply evenly by pressing onto skin.

-Use the puff applicator in areas where shine and oil are more visible. Press onto skin and layer where more coverage and longevity are desired.

-To set powder under the eyes, apply product using the Ambient Lighting Edit Brush (sold separately).


Recycling Instructions:
-Compact plastic parts are made from 100% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic. Carton is made from FSC-certified paper and is widely recyclable

Ingredients+

Mica, Magnesium/Potassium/Silicon/Fluoride/Hydroxide/Oxide, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Silica, Phenyl Trimethicone, Boron Nitride, Calcium Carbonate, Magnesium Myristate, Pentaerythrityl Tetraethylhexanoate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylyl Glycol, Dimethicone, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydrogen Dimethicone, Aluminum Dimyristate, Allantoin, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Isostearic Acid, Tocopherol, Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499).


*Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
